capabilities: Sort, reverse, and shuffle selected lines
Rearrange indentation-based blocks while keeping children attached to their parent
Sort, reverse, and shuffle top-level headings with their content intact
extras: README notes limitations: complex elements like tables, code blocks, and horizontal rules may not behave as expected; works best in source mode.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to reorder lines, paragraphs, list items, or heading sections in bulk, or to sort by how wide text looks on screen.
summary: Plugin that sorts, reverses, or shuffles selected lines, blocks, or headings by lexical order or visual width.
